dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You still owe Lan Mora for drinks. Don't you forget that.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Eh? Oh, so that's what you're here for? Hmph... Alright, alright. These adventurers... Can't ever trust them to come out and speak their minds.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Alright, then. If you have any questions, ask away. I will answer them — provided that I know the answer.
